title: Young Men Waiting in Line, Hallway Clock - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A view from behind of a line of young men and boys queued inside a large hallway or lobby, possibly at a school, community center, or theater. The interior features large paneled double doors, a hanging industrial-deco light fixture, a wall clock, and dark polished floors. The youths wear classic mid-century casual attire, including shorts, slacks, t-shirts, and white crew socks with casual shoes. The right margin bears a date stamp reading 'JUL • 57'.
